parsed_json.up: Select compound identifiers, canonical SMILES, provenance keys, publication links, assay descriptions, and raw activity metadata for IC50 measurements against human B-raf kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Filter by target name 'B-raf kinase' and organism 'Homo sapiens' with standard_type 'IC50'. Return all columns as specified in the expected output. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by all requested columns.
